claim: the negative-drift class at 1667 MHz
locus: Thirteen features under the floor ¶ First (line 122)
quote: First, they sit in the drift class the ATA filter removed. On the night of the Green Bank observation, the object's range-rate was rising (from −1.917 to −1.827 km/s between 04:30 and 05:40 UTC), so a tone on it would drift negative, about −0.12 Hz/s at 1667 MHz. The Green Bank search itself didn't cut by sign.
